verdict.rationale: Devin exposes extensibility hooks—MCP access to "playbooks, knowledge, and scheduling" (devin-docs-6) and an open-source "plugin and skill" for handoff workflows (devin-docs-14)—suggesting some capacity for custom, reusable task logic, but there's no dedicated docs page on authoring/sharing custom skills as a first-class concept. Missing for 10: a documented skills/playbooks authoring guide, examples of building specialized custom skills, and independent verification that custom skills work reliably in practice.
